name: Login Web

endpoints.description: Autentikasi user (Admin/Supervisor/Mill Management) dengan kredensial dan business area, membuat session web

error_codes.condition: business area yang dipilih tidak sesuai dengan akses user
password tidak memenuhi format minimal 6 karakter alfanumerik+simbol, atau field wajib kosong

business_logic: 1. Validate request body (username, password, business_unit_id wajib) → if invalid: return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR
2. Validate format password (min 6 karakter, alfanumerik+simbol) → if invalid: return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR
3. Lookup user by username → if not found/password mismatch: return 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS
4. Check user.is_active → if false: return 403 ACCOUNT_INACTIVE
5. Check business_unit_id cocok dengan akses user → if mismatch: return 403 BUSINESS_AREA_MISMATCH
6. Buat Laravel session untuk user, set session cookie
7. Return 200 dengan user info + redirect_to sesuai role

data_operations.description: SELECT user by username WHERE username = input

edge_case_handling.condition: Kredensial salah (username/NIK atau password tidak cocok)
edge_case_handling.handling: Return 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS, field password dikosongkan di FE
Return 403 ACCOUNT_INACTIVE dengan pesan 'akun tidak aktif, hubungi Admin'

edge_case_handling.condition: Business Area tidak sesuai dengan akses user

business_rules_applied: Password minimal 6 karakter, case-sensitive, kombinasi alfanumerik+simbol
User harus memilih Business Area/Company yang sesuai dengan aksesnya
Redirect setelah login mengikuti role masing-masing

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR when a required field is missing
unit_test_cases.given: request body has username, password, or business_unit_id empty/missing

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR when password format is invalid
unit_test_cases.given: request body password is less than 6 characters, or does not combine alfanumeric+symbol characters

unit_test_cases.description: returns 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS when username not found
returns 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS when password does not match
unit_test_cases.given: userRepo.findByUsername() returns a valid user, but password hash comparison against the supplied password fails

unit_test_cases.description: returns 403 ACCOUNT_INACTIVE when user account is inactive
unit_test_cases.given: userRepo.findByUsername() returns a user with is_active = false, and the password matches

unit_test_cases.description: returns 403 BUSINESS_AREA_MISMATCH when business_unit_id does not match user's access
unit_test_cases.given: user found, is_active = true, password matches, but requested business_unit_id is not among the business units the user has access to

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: userRepo.findByUsername() returns an active user whose password matches and whose access includes the requested business_unit_id; session creation succeeds
unit_test_cases.expect: return 200 with user {id, username, name, role}, business_unit {id, name}, and redirect_to matching the user's role; Laravel session cookie is set

implementation_notes: Rate limiting/lockout setelah percobaan gagal belum diputuskan (open question di business spec)
Sesi login ganda per user/device belum dibatasi di MVP (open question)
Fitur Lupa Password (available_action terpisah) belum punya usecase — di luar scope tech spec ini, menunggu keputusan scope

component_test.action: fill valid username/NIK and password, select a valid Business Area/Company, click the Login button
component_test.assert: loading state is shown during submit, then component triggers redirect to the role-based dashboard, no error message is displayed

browser_test.action: user opens /login, enters valid username/NIK and password, selects a valid Business Area, clicks Login
browser_test.assert: browser is redirected to the role-based dashboard (redirect_to from response), session cookie is set, no error message is shown

component_test.action: fill username/NIK and a password that does not match the account, click the Login button
component_test.assert: error message 'kredensial salah' is displayed, password field is cleared, form remains editable for retry

browser_test.action: user enters mismatched username/NIK and/or password, clicks Login
browser_test.assert: page displays 'kredensial salah' error message, password input is empty, user remains on /login and can retry

component_test.action: fill correct credentials belonging to a deactivated account, select Business Area, click Login
component_test.assert: error message 'akun tidak aktif, hubungi Admin' is displayed, login is rejected

browser_test.action: user with an inactive account enters correct credentials, selects Business Area, clicks Login
browser_test.assert: browser displays 'akun tidak aktif, hubungi Admin' message, user stays on /login, login is rejected

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Login Web — Business Area Tidak Sesuai

component_test.action: fill correct credentials, select a Business Area/Company not matching the user's access, click Login
component_test.assert: error message indicating business area mismatch is displayed, login is rejected

browser_test.action: user enters correct credentials but selects a Business Area outside their access, clicks Login
browser_test.assert: browser shows the business area mismatch error message, login is rejected, user stays on /login

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Login Web — Format Password Tidak Valid

component_test.action: fill username/NIK and a password shorter than 6 characters (or without a symbol), select Business Area, click Login
component_test.assert: validation error message is displayed stating password must be min 6 characters, alfanumeric+symbol; submission is blocked

browser_test.action: user enters a password not meeting the minimum format requirement (e.g. 'abc'), clicks Login
browser_test.assert: browser displays a validation message about the password format requirement, login is rejected, user remains on /login
